item.title: 20-year-old plaintiff testifies she became addicted to social media as early as 6 in landmark trial
item.description: The woman - identified in court as KGM - is the key plaintiff in the case, which alleges she began using social media as young as age 6 and became dependent on the apps.

item.title: Hundreds of students step up to ballot box at suburban schools for early voting in primary
item.description: Family and friends of the late Reverend Jesse Jackson say one way people can honor him is to vote. Some suburban high schools made it easier for some first-time voters on Thursday.

item.title: Instagram says it will notify parents if teens 'repeatedly' search for terms related to suicide
item.description: Instagram said Thursday it will start alerting parents if their kids repeatedly search for terms clearly associated with suicide or self-harm.

item.title: Mourners, dignitaries pay respects to Rev. Jesse Jackson on 1st day of visitation at Rainbow PUSH
item.description: Crowds of mourners, including many dignitaries, lined up in Chicago as cross-country memorial services for the Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. began Thursday in the city the late civil rights leader called home.

item.title: Man arrested in St. Louis charged with murders of men outside their Little Village jewelry store
item.description: A man arrested in St. Louis is charged with the murders of a suburban father and son last November outside their Little Village jewelry store, officials said.

item.title: Mother demands justice after woman killed in wrong-way crash on I-65 in Northwest Indiana
item.description: A wrong-way crash left one woman dead and two others seriously injured in Northwest Indiana earlier this week, police said. The mother of the 20-year-old who was killed spoke exclusively with ABC7 Chicago as she is demanding justice.

item.title: IL advances Bears bill, IN Gov. Braun signs stadium law as states work to lure team from Chicago
item.description: Illinois lawmakers don't return to Springfield for another two-plus weeks, but they say talks with the Bears continue. Meanwhile, Indiana leaders are looking to close the deal.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery deems Paramount's takeover bid superior to Netflix deal
item.description: Netflix is declining to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery's studio and streaming business.

item.title: Suspect charged after man fatally shot in Brainerd parking lot, Chicago police say
item.description: Murder charges have been filed against the suspect in a South Side shooting that may have involved two co-workers.
